q: Our bank sent an ESG questionnaire with our loan renewal. How should we answer the climate part?
title: Bank ESG questionnaire for a loan
short: Answer only what your records show. Give Scope 1 and 2 from your fuel and electricity bills, the period and the method, and say plainly where you have no data yet. A short, sourced answer reads better to a credit team than a long one that cannot be checked.
audience: MSME borrowers renewing working capital or term loans

ul: Any energy saving or renewable projects.
Exposure to floods, heat or water shortage.
Attach the calculation, not just totals.
Keep the same figures you give buyers, so they match.

senseible: Senseible turns invoices and bills into a dated, fingerprinted emissions record a lender can trace line by line. The lender makes its own credit decision.
